installDescription: Install the app on your phone: it opens full screen from its own icon and starts faster.
installIos: In Safari, tap Share (the square with the arrow), then "Add to Home Screen". The app then opens full screen from its own icon.
installManual: Open your browser's menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" or "Install app", if your browser offers it.
